unresolved_issues.handling: Use explicit standing/one-step start, floor-pogo and squat-jump replacements when needed. Keep original drive/stop boundaries and record actual identity/contact effects; never substitute a movable object for a wall.

unresolved_issues.handling: Verify seat/rearward foot fit inside 0–1 m and full body inside 0–2 m, traction and stopping. Both seated and standing paths now use toes 1 m, drive by 4 m, stop by 9 m. Use documented replacements and record actual exposure.

unresolved_issues.issue: Class 8 crouched hand/foot footprint, linked-contact control and forward-throw containment/ball behavior are unconfirmed
unresolved_issues.handling: Qualify the entire start stance and controlled stopping; use documented isolated/support replacements. Toss only with a suitable light low-rebound floor-rated ball and protected flight/bounce/roll/retrieval inside the ten-metre layout; otherwise use parked swings or the bridge replacement. Record actual contacts, set-downs, work and recovery.

unresolved_issues.issue: Class 9 coupled recovery execution, split-pogo control, fitted seat and shallow rapid unilateral hinge competence are unconfirmed
unresolved_issues.handling: Use scheduled bouts to qualify range, rhythm and nearby contacts. Use explicit simpler running/march, parallel-pogo, arms-only and bridge replacements where needed; log actual identities/counts and any overlap with earlier actual technique. Keep strength doses held and review calf/hamstring response before changing demand.

unresolved_issues.issue: Class 10 individual receiving competence, still bent-over launch, alternating step-over control, wall and suitable closed foot-loop band are unconfirmed
unresolved_issues.handling: Qualify within scheduled attempts and verified setup. Use explicit two-foot receiver, simpler running/march, isolated wall/plank and supine unresisted knee-drive replacements as needed. Keep band light, support foot flat and band opposing lift within fit/stretch limits; no improvised loop/anchor. Record changed exposure and actual recovery, with strength doses held.

unresolved_issues.issue: Class 11 cue access, same-leg horizontal receiver competence, isolated upright exchange control and split-stance ball containment are unconfirmed
unresolved_issues.handling: Qualify the one-cue/one-forward-response setup and use self-start if needed; four opportunities include early/missed responses with no make-up starts. Use shared receivers/nonflight exchanges and nonthrowing replacements where required. Verify floor-rated low-rebound ball behavior, stance, flight/bounce/roll/return and lateral clearance; no added qualification throws. P6 reduced to one set; actual response must guide further change.

unresolved_issues.issue: Class 12 settled unilateral takeoff, brief forward ankle recoil and matched prior A-run observations are unconfirmed
unresolved_issues.handling: Qualify inside scheduled attempts; use documented dynamic/shared-origin/in-place/isolated and nonflight replacements. No comparisons without actual matched observations and no automatic restoration of strength volume. These are delivery conditions recorded in the full-sequence audit.

resume_instruction: The twelve Sprinting prescriptions are finalized; do not generate Class 13 or automatically restart a cycle. Before delivery or further programming, read curriculum.md, progression_ledger.md, all classes, supporting/full_sequence_audit.md, supporting/full_sequence_workload.json, supporting/verification.json and athlete_feedback.md. Verify current references. Review actual athlete attendance/execution, exact drill replacements, loads/range/tempo/RIR, recovery and outside sport/gym/tumbling; unknown response stays unknown. All start defaults/replacements use the corrected 1 m origin and require current stopping qualification. Confirm existing Access & Prepare 1 and real equipment/group/booking fit. Use matched observations to choose a hold, reduction, targeted revision or next training need. Appropriate real maximum-velocity running requires a suitable runway and separate planning; gym scores do not prove sprint improvement. Modify or extend the curriculum only in response to the next user request.
